title: Added a third person view to my game, not sure which I prefer now
author: k0zakinio
selftext:
This is RIDGERUNNERS, the mountain racing game I’m making. Apparently I need to update the description 😅

There’s a [free demo on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4970370/RIDGERUNNERS/?utm_source=reddit_agd2) if you fancy trying it

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: Another reminder of how important sound design is everyone. Also, why not just keep both?

replies.author: k0zakinio
replies.body:
yeah, the sounds I have are really bad at the moment, this is one I think I'm probably going to have to the traditional route, unless you have some suggestions?

I think I will end up allowing either view, it's just more to maintain

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/k0zakinio please add details on how AI was used to make this. Just stating that you used AI doesn't pass the rule. The community is a dev community, add dev details. Rule 4 is there to make sure promotional posts contribute by getting into the process and actual development. There's a real risk of the sub being swamped by self-promotion. If you don't update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: Left-Excitement3829
comments.body: Both. For 3rd person though you may need animations of how they are leaping or running so far / fast.

comments.author: SoundSoftWorks
comments.body: I like 3rd person everything, but keep both!

comments.author: NikopikVR
comments.body: Do you have a VR mode?

replies.author: k0zakinio
replies.body: I've had a few requests for VR but feels like a lot of effort.  But with AI it is probably doable

comments.author: mrpoopistan
comments.body: Third person, and it's not even close.

comments.author: sabertoothedhand
comments.body:
At least watching the video, first person. Much more visceral sense of speed, plus the turning looks crisper when the camera's rotation point isn't offset from the player mod.

If you stick with third person, highly consider some moves which launch the player ahead slightly out of sync with the camera so it has to rubberband catch up. Feels a bit awkward having the camera locked 20 feet back.

comments.author: Ohgood9002
comments.body: Hey looks like we're working on similar traversal systems. Hilariously I also changed from first to third person after I added in better jumping/flipping third person animations. It feels way more fun to see the player model actively flip through the air
